# PasteGuard Documentation Pull Request

Thank you for contributing to PasteGuard documentation.

This repository contains public documentation and product resources for PasteGuard.

The production PasteGuard source code is maintained privately and should not be included in this repository.

---

## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes.

Example:

```text
Updates the Trusted Apps documentation to clarify how organization-managed policies override local settings.
```

---

## Type of Change

Select the relevant option:

- [ ] Documentation correction
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Broken-link fix
- [ ] Detector documentation update
- [ ] Screenshot update
- [ ] FAQ update
- [ ] Security documentation update
- [ ] Privacy documentation update
- [ ] Product-edition documentation update
- [ ] Other public documentation change

---

## Related Issue

If this pull request is related to an existing issue, reference it here.

Example:

```text
Closes #123
```

---

## Files Changed

List the main files changed.

Example:

```text
docs/trusted-apps.md
docs/faq.md
README.md
```

---

## Why This Change Is Needed

Explain the problem being solved.

Example:

```text
The existing documentation did not clearly explain how Trusted Apps behave when an Organization policy is active.
```

---

## Testing / Verification

Describe how you verified the documentation.

Examples:

- checked Markdown rendering
- verified internal links
- confirmed screenshots load correctly
- reviewed terminology
- confirmed examples use synthetic data
- checked that no sensitive information is present

---

## Screenshots

If the pull request changes UI documentation or screenshots, add screenshots here.

Only use:

- real PasteGuard UI
- synthetic test data
- sanitized screenshots

Do not include:

- real credentials
- customer information
- personal identity information
- payment information
- confidential organization data

## Security and Privacy Check

Before submitting, confirm:

- [ ] I have not included real passwords.
- [ ] I have not included real API keys.
- [ ] I have not included access tokens.
- [ ] I have not included private keys.
- [ ] I have not included customer data.
- [ ] I have not included payment data.
- [ ] I have not included identity information.
- [ ] I have not included confidential organization configuration.
- [ ] All example credentials are synthetic.
- [ ] Screenshots have been reviewed for sensitive data.

## Product Naming Check

Confirm that product names are written consistently:

- [ ] PasteGuard
- [ ] PasteGuard Free
- [ ] PasteGuard Pro
- [ ] PasteGuard Organization

Avoid inconsistent names such as:

```text
Paste Guard
Paste-Guard
Pasteguard
PasteGaurd
```

unless quoting external text.
